roles.name: fillPrimary
roles.usage: Strong control fill, including the default primary Button. Pair with labelPrimaryLight for its text and icons; it does not mean success, which uses passable.

roles.name: fillSecondary
roles.usage: Selected or focused surfaces and secondary emphasis, as defined by the component. Choose foreground for the actual background and preserve the component's pairing. Do not add app-painted blur solely because this role is used over an image.

roles.name: fillTertiary
roles.usage: Quiet control fill, including peer toggle controls at rest and inactive tracks where documented. Normally pairs with labelPrimary; preserve each component's state behavior.

roles.name: fillLight
roles.usage: Light background for ListItems and local content items or cells. Pages, bodies, columns, list organizers and large sections remain transparent; application-authored backgrounds must not nest.

roles.name: labelPrimaryLight
roles.usage: Primary text and icons on dark control fills, especially fillPrimary. Keep a control's text and icons consistent unless the design explicitly requires a difference.

roles.name: labelPrimary
roles.usage: Primary body information and icons on light/glass surfaces. A title may use this role when explicitly designed; component titles retain their own defaults, including TitleBar's labelSecondary.

roles.name: labelSecondary
roles.usage: Secondary text and less prominent information; also the default TitleBar title role. Importance alone does not override a component's established color.

roles.name: labelTertiary
roles.usage: Supporting explanations, supplementary information and quieter text; some components also use it for unselected content.

roles.name: labelQuaternary
roles.usage: Placeholders and deliberately subdued text. Do not replace a component's built-in disabled treatment with this role; controls may fade as a whole.

roles.name: lightenHover
roles.usage: Theme role for a hover lightening layer where a component uses it. The current Button family does not draw this role: native hover is spatial, and the Web fallback uses the documented 12% overlay. Do not add a second hover layer.

roles.name: lightenPressed
roles.usage: Pressed-state lightening layer where supported by the component. Preserve existing component behavior; Switch and ListItem do not draw this overlay.

roles.name: dividerLine
roles.usage: A separator where a divider is needed. Prefer spacing and headings for ordinary content grouping; do not use this role to outline every content container.

roles.name: error
roles.usage: Error text, error feedback and component error outlines. This does not authorize decorative borders on ordinary content groups.

roles.name: alert
roles.usage: Warnings, risks and cautionary feedback. Use for the warning meaning rather than a general accent.

roles.name: passable
roles.usage: Success or passed-check feedback. Do not use as the default fill for every positive action.

roles.name: interaction
roles.usage: Interactive emphasis such as links, interactive text and on-state highlights where documented by the component. Not a general content background.
